questions.question: What does git add stage?
options: Every future change to a file
A snapshot of the selected working-tree content
questions.explanation: git add copies the selected content into the index. Later edits must be staged again if you want them in the next commit.

questions.question: What does git switch -c feature create?
options: A new branch named feature and switches to it
A copy of every remote branch
questions.explanation: git switch -c creates a new branch at the chosen starting point (HEAD by default), then checks it out.

questions.question: What does git fetch normally do?
options: Overwrites working-tree files with remote files
Downloads objects and updates remote-tracking references
Merges every remote branch into the current branch
questions.explanation: git fetch downloads repository data and updates remote-tracking references. It does not normally merge changes into your current branch.
